_readme: Titles, captions and alt text for the 2019 photographs. The 45-day photographs use scene-notes.json (shared with the store) and the titles in the Shorecrest catalog.

2019-guadalupepeak.title: Sundown at the Guadalupes
2019-guadalupepeak.line: The first night out. The sun dropping behind the ridge, and nothing between here and there.
2019-guadalupepeak.alt: The sun setting over a long desert ridge, light flaring across dry grass and a fence line beside the highway.

2019-carlsbad.title: Prickly Pear Trail
2019-carlsbad.line: Prickly pear holding on to the hillside above the caverns.
2019-carlsbad.alt: Prickly pear cactus growing on a rocky desert hillside under a bright blue sky.

2019-carlsbad2.title: Underground
2019-carlsbad2.line: A few hundred feet down, where the rock grows in slow motion.
2019-carlsbad2.alt: Pale cave formations lit in the dark, mirrored in a still pool deep inside Carlsbad Caverns.

2019-carlsbad3.title: The Long View
2019-carlsbad3.line: Flat land running all the way to the edge of the sky.
2019-carlsbad3.alt: A vast flat plain stretching to the horizon below a rocky desert slope under a pale gray sky.

2019-whitesands.title: White Sands
2019-whitesands.line: Sand that looks like snow, and a co-pilot who didn't mind either way.
2019-whitesands.alt: A husky in a yellow bandana sitting on bright white gypsum sand under a soft gray sky.

2019-arizona3.title: Welcome to Arizona
2019-arizona3.line: One more state line behind us.
2019-arizona3.alt: The Welcome to Arizona sign beside the highway, with a wooded mountain and scattered clouds behind it.

2019-arizona.title: Westbound
2019-arizona.line: Two lanes, a low sun, and no reason to slow down.
2019-arizona.alt: A straight two-lane highway running toward a low sun under a cloudy sky.

2019-arizona2.title: Snow on the Peaks
2019-arizona2.line: Snow on the mountains, seen from the desert floor.
2019-arizona2.alt: Snow-capped mountains rising beyond dry grassland and a fence line, seen from the highway.

2019-grandcanyon.title: Camp in the Pines
2019-grandcanyon.line: Home for the night: a tent, the truck, and tall pines.
2019-grandcanyon.alt: A black pickup truck and a green tent at a campsite among tall pines under a deep blue sky.

2019-grandcanyon2.title: On the Rim
2019-grandcanyon2.line: Taking in the view from the edge.
2019-grandcanyon2.alt: A husky resting on a rock at the edge of the Grand Canyon, red and orange canyon layers stretching out behind.

2019-horseshoebay.title: Horseshoe Bend
2019-horseshoebay.line: The Colorado River making its slow turn around the rock.
2019-horseshoebay.alt: Horseshoe Bend from the rim, the Colorado River curving around a red sandstone tower, with a person and a dog sitting on the ledge.

2019-zion.title: Into Zion
2019-zion.line: Red walls on both sides and the sun coming over the top.
2019-zion.alt: A husky on a dirt trail in Zion, red canyon walls rising on both sides as the sun flares over the rim.

2019-utah.title: Big Sky Country
2019-utah.line: Heading east under a sky that wouldn't quit.
2019-utah.alt: Wispy white clouds streaked across a blue sky above flat golden grassland and a fence line.

2019-mesaverde.title: The Overlook
2019-mesaverde.line: Sitting with it for a while.
2019-mesaverde.alt: A person sitting on the edge of an overlook above a wide forested canyon lined with layered mesa walls.

2019-mesaverde2.title: Cliff Dwellings
2019-mesaverde2.line: Stone rooms tucked under the cliff, still standing.
2019-mesaverde2.alt: Ancient stone cliff dwellings built under a sandstone overhang, with patches of snow on the slope below.

2019-texas.title: Home Stretch
2019-texas.line: Green grass, big clouds, almost home.
2019-texas.alt: A husky standing in a wide green field under a big sky full of white clouds.
